title: For a Border Tribe, Trump’s Wall Is a Betrayal: ‘They Want to Erase Us’
summary: An escalating confrontation on Native land southwest of Tucson threatens to upend decades of uneasy cooperation between the Tohono O’odham Nation and the United States.
